headline: Google basically confirms the Pixel 11 is getting a price hike
summary: Google VP hints at increased price for the upcoming Pixel 11 phone. RAM supply issues and AI data center demand are cited as reasons. The rumored price hike for the Pixel 11 is not a surprise.

headline: Synth historian Oli Freke will spend big on a good bicycle
summary: Musician and journalist Oli Freke has written extensively on synths and music theory. He authored a book on the evolution of synthesizers from 1963-1995. Despite his tech background, he prioritizes investing in a quality bicycle.

headline: Teenage Engineering’s unique music machines are 30 percent off
summary: Teenage Engineering offers unique grooveboxes blending synthesizers and effects. These devices allow real-time song production with distinctive designs. A wide range of their innovative musical instruments are currently 30% off.

headline: Warner Bros. is suing Amazon for poaching employees
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery has sued Amazon over alleged illegal employee poaching. The lawsuit claims Amazon engaged in a 'lawless employee shopping spree.' Former senior VP Pia Barlow is among the employees allegedly poached.

headline: Rockstar Co-Founder Backs Physical Game Releases Based on Player Demand
summary: Rockstar Games co-founder Dan Houser advocates for physical game releases. He believes companies should offer physical media if there's player demand. This stance supports consumer choice in a growing digital market.

headline: Apple TV's Neuromancer Gets Release Date and First Look
summary: Apple TV's 'Neuromancer' series has a confirmed release date. A fast-paced first look trailer for the cyberpunk show was revealed. Fans can now anticipate the highly-awaited adaptation.

headline: D&D Movie Sequel Script Exists, But Financial Issues Threaten Production
summary: A script for a 'Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves' sequel exists. Co-director Jonathan Goldstein reveals financial hurdles might prevent its production. Fans may not see the sequel due to economic factors.

headline: Highly Anticipated Warhammer 40,000 Animation 'Astartes 2' Gets Release Date
summary: Games Workshop announced the release date for 'Astartes 2.' 'Astartes 2' is the highly anticipated Warhammer 40,000 animated series. Fans have waited years for news on this specific animation.

headline: Police Investigate Tice Company Donations to Reform UK
summary: Police are investigating donations from Richard Tice's company to Reform UK. Britain Means Business, owned by Tice, made two £250,000 donations. The donations occurred in the lead-up to the 2024 general election.

headline: 250,000+ Flee Wildfires in France and Spain
summary: Over a quarter-million people have evacuated due to wildfires in France and Spain. Spain's PM warns of challenging hours ahead as fires rage near Bordeaux. Authorities in France struggle to control widespread blazes.

headline: Tourists Describe Escape from French Wildfires
summary: Families recount their harrowing experiences evacuating during French wildfires. What started as holidays quickly transformed into urgent escape missions. The BBC spoke to tourists affected by the spreading blazes.

headline: India's 'Cockroach' Protest Ends as Education Minister Resigns
summary: India's significant 'cockroach' protest has been called off. The protest concluded following the resignation of the education minister. This public anger expression was aimed at PM Narendra Modi's government.
